Disposable public TLS certificates for Apple trust regression tests.

Generated with cryptography 50.0.1, P-256 keys, and SHA-256 signatures.
Both private keys were generated in memory and discarded. These certificates
are not production credentials or trust anchors and are never installed in
the OS trust store. Only the test-local verifier adds the root as an anchor.

CA: Inverter disposable Apple TLS test CA; CA=true, pathLen=0, keyCertSign;
valid 2025-01-01 through 2036-01-01.
Leaf: tls-fixture.invalid; CA=false, digitalSignature, serverAuth EKU,
DNS SAN tls-fixture.invalid; valid 2026-09-01 through 2027-03-01.
Tests use a fixed verification time of 2026-09-30, independent of wall time.

The older MQTT localhost fixture has a 100-year lifetime; Apple's stricter
certificate policy rejects it, so it cannot serve as the positive control.
